messages: anya: quick design sync 1 playground streaming + prompt library. goals: clarify Pause vs Stop, token counter inside composer (collapsing pill), preserve partials as editable drafts, shortcut for prompt insert. prototype: https://figma.com/redwood/playground-lite ben: +1 on draft-preserve. microcopy ideas: Pause / Stop / Regenerate. keep buttons minimal on mobile. maria: product rule: Stop -> save partial locally (not sent). Regenerate creates new generation entry. sam: engineering: Pause = client pause, keep stream open; Stop = cancel server job. ensure tokens_consumed event emitted even on Stop. will add abort_reason tag. linda: a11y: token pill should be role=status + aria-live=polite. announce: "Generation stopped 1 partial saved." Example: ``` Tokens: 120 ``` ben: UX: show live count while streaming, collapse to icon when idle. show delta +N briefly after regen. maria: also: prompt quick-insert: Cmd+K opens drawer; Enter inserts at caret. If composer not focused, append as draft. sam: backend note: emit final token delta event; if aborted include `aborted=true`. Pause may need keepalive ping. anya: action items: ben update figma (token pill states + microcopy) EOD, sam spike abort+tokens 2d, maria doc flows 1d, linda a11y checklist 2d. follow-up Fri 9am PT. deploy-bot: "Playground streaming design review" Fri 09:00 PT. RSVP here. anya: thanks all 1 leaving thread open for small follow-ups.
